title: JWF-24 - 24kV fuse base for HVCLF current limiting fuses, 200 A, BIL 125 kV
range_short_desc: ฐานฟิวส์แรงสูง 24kV สำหรับฟิวส์จำกัดกระแส HVCLF
description: Joongwon JWF-24 fuse base — ฐานรองฟิวส์แรงสูง 24 kV สำหรับฟิวส์จำกัดกระแสตระกูล HVCLF. Two porcelain post insulators on a galvanised channel base, with a spring fuse clip at one end and a fixed holder at the other, so a fuse is dropped in and latched without tools. Because every HVCLF rating from 2 A to 200 A shares the same 442 mm contact spacing and 510 mm length, one base accepts the whole range — a 24 kV panel can be re-fused to a different rating without changing the mounting. Rated 200 A continuous with a 125 kV BIL impulse withstand, so it is matched to the largest IB-D4 fuse in the family. The base is the item KOEMA certified together with the fuse links, and it is what SAV quotes alongside a fuse when a panel is being built rather than re-fused.

feature_groups.title: Main Feature
items: Accepts the entire HVCLF range, 2 A to 200 A — every rating shares 442 mm contact spacing and 510 mm overall length
Rated 200 A continuous, matched to the largest IB-D4 fuse
Spring fuse clip one end, fixed holder the other — fuse changes need no tools
Two porcelain post insulators on a galvanised steel channel base
Certified by KOEMA together with the IB-D0 to IB-D3 fuse links

feature_groups.title: Typical applications
items: 24 kV 630 A load break switch panels
Distribution transformer and capacitor bank protection assemblies
Replacement base where an existing 24 kV fuse mount is cracked, tracked or has lost clip tension

rows: Type : JWF-24
Rated voltage : 24 kV
Rated current : 200 A
Impulse withstand voltage (BIL) : 125 kV
Accepts : HVCLF fuse links IB-D0, IB-D1, IB-D2, IB-D3, IB-D4 (2 – 200 A)
Fuse clip : spring clip, upper terminal end
Fixed holder : opposite end, with pull ring on the clip for fuse removal
Insulators : two porcelain post insulators
Channel base : galvanised steel, drilled for panel mounting
Terminals : upper and lower flat terminals
Overall width : 613 mm
Insulator centres : 361 mm · terminal centres 313 mm
Overall height with fuse swung open : 632 mm (590 mm to the pivot)
Depth : 241 mm
Fuse opening angle : 38°
Mounting hole pitch : 380 mm along the channel, 260 mm between channels on a 3-phase assembly
Mounting holes : Ø15 mm and Ø12.5 mm
Base plate width : 80 mm, edge offset 35 mm

Standard : IEC 60282-1
KOEMA certificate 2004-라-010 : base JWF-24 with links IB-D1 / IB-D2 / IB-D3, 24 kV 50 kA
KOEMA certificate 2007-가-085 : base JWF-24 with link IB-D0, 24 kV 2 A 31.5 kA back-up
Manufacturer : Joongwon Electric Corporation (중원전기), Ansan-si, Gyeonggi-do, Korea — ISO 9001 and ISO 14001
